arguments.newText:
# This hook creates a high-compression tarball of the *entire working directory*,
# including untracked files and node_modules.
#
# NOTE: This can be slow and create large archives.

REPO_ROOT="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)"
cd "$REPO_ROOT"

STAMP="$(date -u +%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ)"
OUT_DIR="$REPO_ROOT/.git/pre-push-archives"
OUT_TAR="$OUT_DIR/workdir-$STAMP.tar.zst"

mkdir -p "$OUT_DIR"

# Prefer zstd (very fast + high ratio). If zstd isn't available, fall back to xz.
if command -v zstd >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  # -19: high compression (adjust if too slow)
  # --long=31: larger window for better compression on big trees
  # -T0: all cores
  tar -I 'zstd -19 --long=31 -T0' -cf "$OUT_TAR" .
else
  OUT_TAR="$OUT_DIR/workdir-$STAMP.tar.xz"
  # -9e: max xz compression (slow)
  tar -cJf "$OUT_TAR" .
fi

echo "pre-push: created archive: $OUT_TAR" >&2

exit 0
